system:
You write triage summaries of companies for a team that vets suppliers and project partners. The reader has about 30 seconds and must decide whether the company deserves a closer look.

Rules:
1. Use ONLY the facts provided. Never calculate, estimate or add outside knowledge. Copy figures exactly as written.
2. Lead with what matters most: the HIGH signals first, then MEDIUM. Mention INFO signals only if they add useful context.
3. If financial statements are missing, say so plainly. Never imply figures that are not provided.
4. State which financial year the latest figures are from, because they may be out of date.
5. Court cases that are not listed under the signals are settled, withdrawn, dismissed, or brought by the company itself. Do not present them as concerns.
6. Be neutral and factual. Do not recommend for or against doing business with the company.
7. 70 to 110 words. Plain Markdown, no headings.
prompt:
Write the summary for this company.

Structure: one opening sentence saying what the company is (name, industry, state, year incorporated), then the most important risks and facts, with the most serious first. If there are no significant signals, say so and give the headline financial position instead.

Company: Sejahtera Kirana Resort Sdn. Bhd. (SYN-001618)
Industry: Hospitality | State: Perlis | Status: Active
Business: Travel agency for umrah and inbound tourism
Incorporated: 2012-04-13 | Share capital: RM100,000
Board: 2 director(s); 0 appointed in the 12 months to 31 Dec 2025
Largest shareholder: 100.0%
Financial years available: FY2022, FY2023, FY2024 (latest year end 2024-03-31)
FY2022: revenue RM9.47m, profit after tax -RM760,535, equity RM6.22m, operating cash flow -RM793,737, audit: Unqualified
FY2023: revenue RM9.04m, profit after tax -RM1.14m, equity RM5.08m, operating cash flow -RM1.05m, audit: Unqualified
FY2024: revenue RM8.19m, profit after tax -RM1.26m, equity RM3.81m, operating cash flow -RM1.05m, audit: Unqualified
Court cases: 0 total (0 as defendant, 0 as plaintiff); open cases against company: 0
Risk and context signals (computed, already verified):
- [HIGH] Loss-making in each of the last 3 years; latest loss -RM1.26m (FY2024).
- [MEDIUM] Revenue fell 14% from RM9.47m (FY2022) to RM8.19m (FY2024).
- [MEDIUM] Operating cash flow was negative (-RM1.05m) in FY2024.
- [MEDIUM] Operating profit does not cover interest expense in FY2024 (cover -16.0x).
- [MEDIUM] Current liabilities (RM3.71m) exceed current assets (RM3.57m) in FY2024.
- [INFO] One shareholder holds 100.0% of the company.
- [INFO] Part-owned by other companies: Murni Holdings Sdn. Bhd. (100.0%).
response:
Sejahtera Kirana Resort Sdn. Bhd. is an active hospitality travel agency in Perlis, incorporated in 2012. 

The company presents multiple financial risks based on its FY2024 figures. It has been loss-making for the last three consecutive years, with the latest profit after tax at -RM1.26m in FY2024. Additionally, revenue fell 14% from RM9.47m in FY2022 to RM8.19m in FY2024. In FY2024, operating cash flow was negative at -RM1.05m, operating profit did not cover interest expense (cover -16.0x), and current liabilities of RM3.71m exceeded current assets of RM3.57m. Audits for all three years were unqualified, and there are zero court cases.
